The proof combines root normalization with the affine prime test, tracking degree-only parameters through local weights, the kernel and induction. The content divisibility is already paid. **No substantial-result nomination is made:** the adaptation appears to be a routine source composition. Independent correctness and contribution reviews remain outstanding.

A distinct prime-thinning extension was tested and obstructed by an explicit phase-mask example.
